head_commit.message:
fix: restore module release pipeline after i18n test regressions

- shell-bridge test: mock ipcMain.on and expect the documented setLocale channel
- preload-api test: allow-list the new setLocale bridge member
- MarkdownMessage test: await the rAF-deferred reparse on text change
- vitest: give jsdom a non-opaque origin and shim window.localStorage, which
  Node >= 22 shadows with its undefined experimental global
- renderer: restore the space between translated labels and values broken by
  the i18n switch (capability recipe, goal, model picker, operations,
  overview, plan review, safety, scheduled, task timeline, workflow,
  workspace checkpoints panels)
- publish-compatible-manifest: refuse to publish a compatible set whose
  updater component is below the required minimum version; such a manifest
  bricks every installed updater with the version-below-requirement error
